results.content: Correction: the 600-second merge-lane verify timeout is outdated. Since the coalesce-train rollout the lane runs every verify under a 900-second ceiling, set as git.merge_verify_timeout_seconds in dark-factory-orchestrator.yaml, and a verify that overruns it is parked as verify_timeout rather than retried. Plan around 900 seconds, not 600.
